author: GamingBolt
description:
Crimson Desert was a massive game, to be sure. We did expect its latest Charting the Unknown DLC to be huge too, but that’s now an understatement after we spent time with it. From sailing the seas to rummaging through the depths for loot, this one’s a journey that’s going to take many more weekends before you see all of what it’s offering.

We don’t say that lightly, and if you’re wondering why we feel that way, we’d love for you to hop on board our ship as we take a voyage across the vast new ocean we must now explore in its entirety, thanks to how intriguing the stuff it offers us is. It’s time to cast off and sail into an expansion that often feels like it’s too big and too good to be true.
title: Crimson Desert: Charting The Unknown Is Almost ABSURDLY HUGE

author: GamingBolt
description:
There’s so much official information about GTA 6 now flying around after such a long and insufferable silence, and we’re thankful for that. But we suspect that what we know barely scratches the surface of a game that we believe has many more nifty tricks up its sleeve.

We haven’t forgotten how GTA 5 turned our own expectations upside down when it first came out, and how its three protagonists, heists, and the open world made us feel like we were never going to manage to see everything the experience had to offer. Of course, the long gap between instalments in the franchise has helped alleviate those concerns somewhat, and it’s now time to look to the future.

To that end, we’ve compiled some key differences between the two titles based on official information about the upcoming flagship from Rockstar. Let’s go!
title: GTA 6 vs GTA 5 - 15 BIGGEST Differences You May Not Know
